newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish lower house vote on '97 taxes seen Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Polish lower house vote on '97 taxes seen Thursday.

text.p: The lower house of Poland's parliament is likely to discuss upper house amendments to the 1997 tax bill on Wednesday and vote on them on Thursday, the parliamentary press office said.
It said the schedule was suggested by the lower house presidium, but could yet be changed during the setting up of the agenda at the start of the session at 1400 GMT on Tuesday.

Last week the upper house, the Senate, changed the tax bill passed by the lower house, the Sejm, by introducing personal income tax levels of 20, 32 and 44 percent instead of the Sejm's 17, 20, 33 and 45 percent.
The Sejm can reject the Senate's amendments with a simple majority of those present during the vote.
